# Ailiur

> Ailiur builds AI-first outcome engines for learning, health, creativity, personal
> intelligence, and work. Each product is a focused app that produces a real outcome;
> all of them are connected by the Unified Context Mesh, a private, local-first context
> layer so progress in one app compounds across the others.

Positioning: AI-first outcome engines for a better human life.
Connective layer: the Unified Context Mesh (private, local-first, on-device by default).
Status: pre-launch. Founder Access reservations are open at https://www.ailiur.com/#founder-access

## Core products

- Qetos (health): Metabolic & energy tracking — educational, never diagnostic. https://qetos.ailiur.com
- Enchiridion (learning): Guided learning that adapts to how you actually learn. https://www.enchiridion.ailiur.com
- Oruvo (personal intelligence): Your life balance sheet — assets, goals, and time ROI. https://www.ailiur.com/oruvo
- Tayzt (creativity): An AI-native atmosphere engine for creators. https://www.ailiur.com/tayzt
- Tellumetry (work): Calm telemetry around your AI coding agents and projects. https://www.ailiur.com/tellumetry
- Iris (personal intelligence): A personal intelligence interface. Coming soon.
- Civis (work): Civic and organizational intelligence. Coming soon.
- Unified Context Mesh / UCM: The private context layer that lets one Ailiur app improve another, with consent. https://www.ailiur.com/ucm

## Outcome domains

- Learning: Enchiridion, Aptellum
- Health: Qetos, Daymesh
- Creativity: Tayzt, Retellum
- Personal intelligence: Oruvo, Iris
- Work: Tellumetry, Civis

## Principles

- Local-first & sovereign: data lives on-device and is never sent anywhere unless you explicitly sync or share it.
- Closed-loop: each engine measures its own output against your targets and tunes itself.
- One context: the Unified Context Mesh connects every app with sub-millisecond, consent-based retrieval.
